title: helianthemum oelandicum subsp. italicum
intro: Helianthemum oelandicum subsp. italicum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include analgesic, anti-histaminic, and anti-oxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, allergies, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
